name: Finance
description: Categorise exported transactions, draft invoices, explain monthly budget differences in plain words and check expense lists against your own rules. Drafts only; never pays.
descriptionFa: دسته‌بندی تراکنش‌های خروجی‌گرفته‌شده، پیش‌نویس فاکتور، توضیح ساده‌ی تفاوت‌های ماهانه‌ی بودجه و بررسی فهرست هزینه‌ها بر پایه‌ی قوانین خودتان؛ فقط پیش‌نویس و بدون پرداخت.

sampleTasks.title: Categorise last month's exported transactions for a small bakery
sampleTasks.description: Using the exported transaction file in the folder I name, assign each line to one of my categories and list every line you cannot categorise, with the reason.

sampleTasks.title: Draft an invoice for a catering job
sampleTasks.description: Prepare a draft invoice for an invented customer: three line items, quantities, unit prices and a payment term of 30 days. Leave tax details marked TO CONFIRM.

sampleTasks.title: Explain the monthly budget variance in plain words
sampleTasks.description: Compare the budget and actual figures in the two files I provide for a design studio and explain the five biggest differences in plain words with a short table.
